contract: X.Org twm 1.0.13.1 Milestone 7 icon and icon-manager reference behavior

matching.duplicate_rule: Lists are prepended while parsed, so the last configured matching entry wins within each matching field.

directives.name: DontIconifyByUnmapping
directives.rule: Excludes matching ordinary clients from a global IconifyByUnmapping policy.

directives.name: ForceIcons
directives.rule: A usable matching Icons bitmap overrides client IconPixmapHint and IconWindowHint.

directives.name: IconBackground
directives.rule: Selects the compositor-owned icon background, with per-window matching.

directives.name: IconBorderColor
directives.rule: Selects the compositor-owned icon border color, with per-window matching.

directives.name: IconBorderWidth
directives.rule: Adds an external border on every compositor-owned icon window and participates in region allocation size.

directives.name: IconDirectory
directives.rule: Is tried only after bitmapFilePath lookup fails and only for a relative bitmap name.

directives.name: IconFont
directives.rule: Measures and draws the icon label and determines label height.

directives.name: IconForeground
directives.rule: Selects the compositor-owned icon text and copied bitmap foreground, with per-window matching.

directives.name: IconifyByUnmapping
directives.rule: Without a list it applies globally except DontIconifyByUnmapping and icon-manager windows; with a list it additionally enables matching clients.

directives.name: IconManagerBackground
directives.rule: Selects manager entry backgrounds, with per-window matching.

directives.name: IconManagerDontShow
directives.rule: A matching blacklist always suppresses an entry; the no-argument form changes IconManagerShow into a whitelist.

directives.name: IconManagerFont
directives.rule: Determines entry label rendering and the minimum row height.

directives.name: IconManagerForeground
directives.rule: Selects manager entry text and inner-border colors, with per-window matching.

directives.name: IconManagerGeometry
directives.rule: Sets the default manager base width, initial position, and requested column count; rows grow to fit entries.

directives.name: IconManagerHighlight
directives.rule: Selects the active entry outer-border color when global highlighting is enabled.

directives.name: IconManagers
directives.rule: Allocates additional named managers and routes matching clients to the first matching list record, otherwise to the default manager.

directives.name: IconManagerShow
directives.rule: When IconManagerDontShow is global, permits only matching clients to receive entries.

directives.name: IconRegion
directives.rule: Adds ordered first-fit regions with vertical and horizontal split gravity and allocation rounded to the configured grid.

directives.name: Icons
directives.rule: Selects a bitmap by name, resource name, or class; relative files use normal bitmap lookup and then IconDirectory.

directives.name: NoCaseSensitive
directives.rule: Uses ISO Latin-1 case-insensitive comparison for manager sorting instead of strcmp.

directives.name: NoIconManagers
directives.rule: Prevents manager creation and all client manager entries.

directives.name: NoRaiseOnDeiconify
directives.rule: Maps restored frames without raising them.

directives.name: ShowIconManager
directives.rule: Maps the default manager at startup only when it has entries and managers are enabled.

directives.name: SortIconManager
directives.rule: Maintains entries in icon-name order and re-sorts after icon-name changes.

directives.name: StartIconified
directives.rule: For matching clients, forces the initial WM state hint to IconicState; initial iconification suppresses zoom animation.

directives.name: UnknownIcon
directives.rule: Provides the fallback bitmap after forced/configured and client image sources fail.

directives.name: WarpCursor
directives.rule: Warps to a deiconified window when globally enabled or the client matches the list.

directives.name: Zoom
directives.rule: Draws the configured number of intermediate root-window outlines twice between frame and icon geometries.

actions.name: f.backiconmgr
actions.rule: Previous list entry with wrap in the active manager.

actions.name: f.deiconify
actions.rule: Deiconifies only an iconified target.

actions.name: f.delete
actions.rule: Targeting any icon-manager window hides the default manager instead of sending WM_DELETE_WINDOW to twm itself.

actions.name: f.destroy
actions.rule: Targeting an icon-manager window rings the minor-error bell instead of killing twm.

actions.name: f.downiconmgr
actions.rule: Next row in the same column with wrap.

actions.name: f.forcemove
actions.rule: Moves an icon like f.move while bypassing screen-edge clamping and records a changed icon as user-moved.

actions.name: f.forwiconmgr
actions.rule: Next list entry with wrap in the active manager.

actions.name: f.hideiconmgr
actions.rule: Withdraws and unmaps the default icon manager.

actions.name: f.iconify
actions.rule: Toggles an iconified target back to normal, otherwise iconifies it at the invocation-derived fallback position.

actions.name: f.lefticonmgr
actions.rule: Previous column in the same row with wrap.

actions.name: f.lower
actions.rule: Lowers the icon window when invoked on an icon, otherwise lowers the client frame.

actions.name: f.move
actions.rule: Moves the selected icon and records a changed icon as user-moved for later region behavior.

actions.name: f.nexticonmgr
actions.rule: Next nonempty mapped manager, wrapping across screens.

actions.name: f.previconmgr
actions.rule: Previous nonempty mapped manager, wrapping across screens.

actions.name: f.raise
actions.rule: Raises the invoked icon outside root WindowFunction context, otherwise raises the client frame.

actions.name: f.raiselower
actions.rule: Applies Opposite stacking to the invoked icon, or to the frame when not invoked on the icon.

actions.name: f.righticonmgr
actions.rule: Next column in the same row with wrap.

actions.name: f.showiconmgr
actions.rule: Deiconifies and raises the default manager.

actions.name: f.sorticonmgr
actions.rule: Sorts the active manager or a selected manager window immediately.

actions.name: f.upiconmgr
actions.rule: Previous row in the same column with wrap.

actions.name: f.warptoiconmgr
actions.rule: Raises and warps to the current or icon-name-prefix-selected visible manager entry; failure rings the minor-error bell.

icon_window_contract.precedence_qualification: IconWindowHint replaces the whole icon surface when no usable forced bitmap exists. IconPixmapHint is evaluated before the nonforced Icons list. A configured name whose bitmap cannot be loaded does not block later fallbacks.

rules.rule: WM_ICON_NAME supplies the label; absent or null WM_ICON_NAME falls back to WM_NAME.
Owned width is max(text_width + 6, bitmap_width); text x is 3 when text dominates, otherwise centered plus 3; height is bitmap_height + font_height + 4 and baseline y is bitmap_height + font_height.
The owned window uses IconBorderWidth, per-client icon border/background colors, and per-client foreground for label and 1-bit image expansion.
IconPositionHint bypasses region allocation; otherwise the first fitting region is used, then the caller-provided fallback, with only coordinates beyond the right/bottom display edge clamped.
Changing WM_ICON_NAME resizes and redraws owned icons and may re-sort a manager; non-forced WM_HINTS can replace or remove a client icon window and update a client pixmap.
Ordinary clients with iconify_by_unmapping true get no mapped icon window; transients still use the visible group icon path. Icon-manager mini-buttons remain the iconified marker in either policy.
Iconify unmaps client and frame while suppressing the synthetic withdrawal transition, sets WM_STATE IconicState, clears focus, and records icon/icon_on separately.
Deiconify maps client and frame, sets NormalState, unmaps icon and manager marker, releases the region allocation, and clears icon/icon_on.
Iconifying or restoring an owner applies the state transition to all matching transients, using the owner/group icon for animation where needed.
X geometry offsets are relative to display edges when negative; nonpositive grid dimensions become one pixel.

Scan regions and their split-entry lists in declaration/allocation order; reserve the first unused rectangle large enough for border-inclusive dimensions rounded up independently to grid width and height.
The vertical gravity is the primary split direction and horizontal gravity secondary; South/East reserve against the bottom/right side while North/West reserve against top/left.
Center the actual border-inclusive icon inside its rounded allocation cell.
Only unused rectangles can be selected, so owned allocations do not overlap; release merges edge-adjacent compatible free rectangles in both predecessor and successor directions.
A client position hint is never reflowed. A user-moved icon is reallocated only if its center lies within a configured region; otherwise it remains where moved.

Exclude manager windows, transients, disabled managers, blacklist matches, and non-whitelisted clients under global DontShow; route remaining clients by name/res_name/res_class to a configured manager or default.

Each row height is max(font_height + 10, iconify_bitmap_height + 4); cell width is configured base width divided by requested columns; list order fills rows left-to-right and adds rows, with a partial last row shrinking the live manager width to used columns.
Append in management order unless SortIconManager is active; sorting compares icon names and is stable for equal names. Icon-name changes trigger sorting only when continuous sorting is enabled.
Adding increments count, repacks, and shows a non-iconified manager; removal unlinks and destroys both entry windows, decrements, repacks, and unmaps an empty manager.

Entries draw the icon name after a fixed iconify-button gutter; the small iconify glyph is visible only while the client is iconified. The active row uses the configured highlight outer border when Highlight is enabled.
Entering an entry makes it Active, directs focus/activation to its client under normal focus policy, and leaving clears its active highlight; pressing the entry temporarily draws its down border.

Forward/back follow linked-list order with wrap. Up/down/left/right search wrapped row/column coordinates within the active manager. A mapped manager is raised and pointer-warped to the target mini-button; a hidden manager warps to the client title/client instead.

Next/previous manager skips empty or unmapped managers, wraps through managed screens, raises the destination, and warps to its active entry or manager window; no destination rings the minor-error bell.
f.warptoiconmgr with an empty string uses the target client's manager entry or default active entry; a nonempty string selects the first visible entry whose icon name has that prefix.
StartIconified overwrites/creates StateHint IconicState for matching clients; the first MapRequest calls Iconify with Zoom temporarily disabled.

Visible iconification zooms frame to icon after transient processing; deiconification zooms icon to frame before mapping. Zoom is a no-op if disabled, count is below one, or either endpoint is absent.
Deiconification maps frames raised by default; NoRaiseOnDeiconify selects plain mapping for owner and transients.
f.raise/f.lower/f.raiselower target the icon window when invoked on an icon, otherwise the frame; manager navigation raises a visible manager frame.

operations: Vary ForceIcons, usable/missing Icons entries, IconPixmapHint, IconWindowHint, UnknownIcon, absolute/relative bitmap names, and WM_ICON_NAME.
oracle: Assert the exact six-level qualified precedence order.
Compare owned/client surface identity, bitmap pixels, label text, colors, border, and geometry to reference screenshots.

operations: Cross global/list IconifyByUnmapping with DontIconifyByUnmapping, ordinary/transient/manager clients, and manager visibility.
oracle: Compare icon-window mapping, manager marker mapping, client/frame mapping, WM_STATE, focus, and recovery route after every transition.

operations: Create variable-sized icons in a fixed order, destroy alternating allocations, create replacements, then repeat the exact event stream.
oracle: Record border-inclusive allocation rectangles after every operation.
Require exact reference coordinates on every replay and no overlap among live owned icons.

operations: Exercise North/South crossed with East/West, non-divisible icon sizes, nonpositive grids, negative geometry, multiple ordered regions, one partially occupied region, and one full region.
oracle: Compare rounded cell sizes, split order, centering, spill to the next region, fallback placement, and screenshots.

operations: Mix IconPositionHint icons with region icons; move allocated icons inside and outside regions; deiconify and re-iconify.
oracle: Position hints remain exact and unallocated; outside moved icons remain fixed; inside moved icons return to reference allocation behavior.
Apply the no-overlap invariant only to reserved owned allocations and record reference overlaps or stale reservations caused by unallocated hinted/moved icons rather than normalizing them away.

operations: Vary name/res_name/res_class routes, Show/DontShow lists, duplicate icon names, case sensitivity, rename events, sorted and append modes, and partial final rows.
oracle: Compare manager assignment, stable order, row/column coordinates, live geometry, per-row pixels, and empty-manager unmapping.

operations: Enter, leave, press, release, focus, iconify, and deiconify each manager entry with Highlight enabled and disabled.
oracle: Compare active/down borders, keyboard focus target, marker glyph mapping, client activation, and screenshots after each event.

operations: Invoke forward, back, up, down, left, and right from every cell, including partial last rows and hidden-manager state.
oracle: Compare every destination row/column, wrap, raise, focus, and pointer coordinate to a reference trace.

operations: Map empty, populated, visible, and hidden managers on both outputs; run next/previous and named/empty f.warptoiconmgr routes in both directions.
oracle: Map each Wayland output to the corresponding reference X screen and compare skip/wrap order, destination entry, raise state, pointer destination, bell failures, and screenshots.

operations: Start matching and nonmatching clients with conflicting StateHint values; repeatedly iconify/deiconify owners and transients with Zoom counts 0, 1, and 8 and NoRaiseOnDeiconify toggled.
oracle: Initial iconification has no outline; later transitions match outline endpoints/count/order and owner/transient stacking behavior.

operations: Repeatedly create, iconify, rename, deiconify, close, and recreate a deterministic large client set while periodically sorting and hiding/showing managers.
oracle: After every batch require no stale manager entries, duplicate clients, overlapping live allocations, lost free space, or nondeterministic order.
At completion require zero client entries and fully reusable icon regions.
